preregistration.expectation: Two independent checks: (1) rerun the retained graceful stop/retry job-recovery acceptance (blueprints/convergence-practice/job-recovery/{run.py,fixture.py}), which passed on 2.16.6 (evidence/receipts/native-dagu-job-recovery-20260920.json), against the 2.17.0 binary and expect the same pass shape (aborted -> retry --step finalize -> succeeded, checkpoint reused, 12-test oracle). (2) rerun PR #81's dagu-inflight-resume-after-kill fixture (SIGKILL mid-step, then attempt recovery) but hold at least 120s after the kill before the recovery attempts -- past both of Dagu's documented thresholds (lock_stale_threshold default 30s, heartbeat stale_threshold default 90s) -- plus an immediate post-kill history/ps check, since the original PR #81 run only waited ~1-2s and was recorded as inconclusive/narrowed by a Codex review to 'inconclusive' rather than 'refutes_incumbent'.
preregistration.criteria: (1) passes iff command_exit_codes are all 0, before_retry_status=='aborted', after_retry_status=='succeeded', same_native_run_id==true, and checkpoint_sha256_unchanged is stable with checkpoint_tests==12. (2) is conclusive (rather than inconclusive) iff the recovery attempt happens strictly after the 120s hold and the run's history/marker state is captured both immediately after the kill and after the hold; the specific pass/fail of the recovery attempt itself does not by itself constitute a regression unless 2.16.6 behavior differed under an equivalent hold, which was never tested (see limits).

acceptance_check_ref: evidence/receipts/native-dagu-job-recovery-20260920.json (retained 2.16.6 acceptance) and evidence/artifacts/gap-resolution-20260922/data-quality-orchestration/dagu-inflight-resume-after-kill.json on branch origin/claude/gap-resolution-20260922 (PR #81, open, not merged; ~1-2s hold, recorded verdict_impact.direction changed from refutes_incumbent to inconclusive by a Codex coordinator correction dated 2026-09-23)

results.job_recovery_acceptance: PASSED on 2.17.0, matching the 2.16.6 retained receipt shape exactly (graceful stop -> targeted --step retry -> succeeded, checkpoint reused, 12/12 tests, same run-id).
results.inflight_resume_after_kill: Past the 120s hold (exceeding both the documented 30s lock_stale_threshold and 90s heartbeat stale_threshold), the killed run was STILL refused by both `dagu start --run-id <same>` ('already exists') and `dagu retry --run-id` ('already running... socket=/tmp/@dagu_inflight_<hash>.sock'), and `dagu history` still reported status 'running' 2m31s after the original kill. This settles PR #81's open question: even after both documented thresholds elapse, Dagu 2.17.0 does not self-heal or allow recovery of a run whose process was SIGKILLed mid-step; the stale unix-socket lock file (and/or persisted history status) outlives the documented thresholds. This is the SAME class of behavior PR #81 observed at ~1-2s (not a regression from 2.16.6, since 2.16.6 was never tested at 120s either), now confirmed conclusive rather than inconclusive because the hold exceeded both named thresholds.

limits: The inflight-resume-after-kill result is native_proven for 2.17.0 only; 2.16.6 was never rerun with an equivalent 120s hold, so this receipt cannot state whether 2.17.0's non-recovery-past-threshold behavior differs from 2.16.6's (both are simply untested at 120s on 2.16.6). No regression is claimed for this reason -- 'qualified' reflects that 2.17.0 passes the retained graceful-recovery acceptance and that the inflight-kill gap is now conclusively characterized (not that the inflight-kill outcome is itself a pass/fail criterion for the pin).

A manual `dagu stop` or manual deletion of the stale socket file before retrying was still not tried in this rerun (same limitation PR #81 recorded); whether either of those recovers the run past the threshold remains untested.

The job-recovery acceptance harness was copied out of the repository into a scratch directory and its hardcoded '2.16.6' version guard and ROOT/EVAL_DIR path constants were edited in the copy (not in the tracked blueprints/convergence-practice/job-recovery/run.py file, which is unmodified) so it would accept 2.17.0 and resolve paths correctly outside its original location; the tracked repository fixture itself was not changed.
Single run, single host (WSL2), single Dagu version (2.17.0) for each check; not repeated for statistical confidence.

No broker/paid-API/credential use. Installed only into /home/example/.cache/sota-refresh-20260923/pins-runtime/dagu/, no PATH binary or ~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/dagu (still 2.16.6) was modified.
